summaries.Romania: Romania faces political realignment with PNL positioning Ilie Bolojan as opposition leader while the Niculescu government navigates budget deficits and infrastructure challenges. Key security concerns emerge around Black Sea attacks affecting maritime commerce and regional stability.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation focuses on cancer vaccines showing promise, with regulatory scrutiny of drug benefits increasing while Medicaid work requirements loom and workforce challenges persist across health systems. Investment and AI applications are transforming patient management and drug discovery.
summaries.Tech: Apple's iPhone Duo launches to strong demand with long lines returning to stores, while the tech industry grapples with AI safety (OpenAI cuts internet access for training), security vulnerabilities in PHP affecting 70% of websites, and ongoing antitrust pressures on major platforms.

items.title: O piață de mii de miliarde de dolari. La cât vor ajunge cheltuielile globale pentru centrele de date în următorii ani
items.snippet: Cheltuielile globale pentru centrele de date ar urma să ajungă la 1.000 de miliarde de dolari în 2026 şi se vor dubla până la 2.100 de miliarde de dolari la nivelul anului 2028, fiind impulsionate de cererea tot mai mare pentru serviciile de inteligenţă artificială (AI), au estimat analiştii de la B
items.line: Global data center spending projected to hit $2.1 trillion by 2028 driven by AI demand, representing massive infrastructure investment opportunity for Romania's tech sector.

items.title: STAT+: Highly anticipated Moderna-Merck melanoma cancer vaccine data arrived early
items.snippet: In data released at ESMO, the Moderna-Merck personalized mRNA cancer vaccine reduced recurrence-free survival and the time until distant metastasis occurred.
items.line: Moderna-Merck personalized mRNA melanoma vaccine reduces recurrence risk by 42%, advancing precision oncology and cancer vaccine innovation with major clinical implications.

items.title: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”
items.snippet: OpenAI will cut frontier models off from the internet weeks after one of its engineers said that solution wouldn't work.
items.line: OpenAI cuts internet access for frontier model training citing significant risks, marking major shift in AI safety practices amid security concerns and hacking incidents.

items.title: Lab testing giant Quest Diagnostics confirms patients’ personal and health data was compromised during breach
items.snippet: Quest is the latest in a series of healthcare technology companies that have been hacked in recent months.
items.line: Quest Diagnostics confirms patient health data breach, continuing pattern of healthcare tech company hacks threatening sensitive personal and medical information.

items.title: Dragoș Pîslaru: România ar putea avea 60 de miliarde de euro din fonduri europene din 2028. De ce propune un plan național de dezvoltare: „Politicienii probabil că vor aloca banii prin alocări de tip siloz. Mediul de afaceri trebuie să spună clar: nu se face acest plan fără noi”
items.snippet: România ar putea avea la dispoziție aproximativ 60 de miliarde de euro în finanțări europene nerambursabile începând din 2028, dar trebuie să pregătească din timp un plan național de dezvoltare care să reunească fondurile europene, banii de la bugetul de stat și capitalul privat, susține Dragoș Pîsl
items.line: Romania could access €60 billion in European funds from 2028 onward if it develops a comprehensive national development plan integrating EU, state, and private capital.

items.title: „PSD şi-a găsit naşul”. Lider PNL: Ilie Bolojan e cel care va înjumătăţi numărul de parlamentari ai fostului partid comunist
items.snippet: Vicepreşedintele PNL, Alexandru Muraru, susţine că Ilie Bolojan va fi coşmarul PSD în anii care urmează şi că liderul PNL va ajunge liderul opoziţiei şi va înjumătăţi numărul de parlamentari ai PSD.
items.line: PNL positions Ilie Bolojan as opposition leader capable of halving PSD's parliamentary representation, signaling major political realignment ahead of next elections.

items.title: STAT+: Most cancer drugs approved by European regulators lack a high clinical benefit, analysis finds
items.snippet: Most new cancer medicines approved by European regulators over a recent four-year period do not offer high clinical benefit, a new analysis finds.
items.line: Most new cancer drugs approved in Europe lack high clinical benefit, raising questions about regulatory standards and drug pricing for limited therapeutic advancement.

items.title: Uninsured rate climbs to 11.2% in 2026: Commonwealth Fund
items.snippet: The uninsured rate has climbed over the past two years as Medicaid work requirements—which are expected to drive their own coverage losses—loom at the beginning of 2027.
items.line: U.S. uninsured rate climbs to 11.2% as Medicaid work requirements loom in 2027, threatening coverage losses for millions and straining health system capacity.

items.snippet:

items.title: OpenAI now trains its frontier AI models with no internet access
items.snippet: OpenAI is now training its most advanced AI models without internet access following a string of rogue hacking incidents. In a blog post on Friday, OpenAI says it built an offline testing environment where AI models can interact with indexed and cached web content "without risk of affecting external
items.line: OpenAI trains frontier models offline with cached content only, responding to rogue hacking incidents and reducing exposure to live internet threats and data exfiltration.

items.title: Elicopter Black Hawk, misiune în Marea Neagră, pentru căutarea marinarilor dispăruţi de pe nava atacată vineri
items.snippet: Un elicopter Black Hawk realizează, sâmbătă, o misiune în Marea Neagră, pentru căutarea celor trei marinari dispăruţi de pe nava atacată vineri, anunță Inspectoratul General al Aviaţiei. Până în prezent, nouă marinari au fost salvați, trei sunt dați dispăruți iar unul a murit.
items.line: Black Sea maritime attacks continue with three sailors missing from vessel hit by drones, highlighting escalating security threats to regional commerce and Romanian waters.

items.title: Crackgate? iPhone Duo Owners Report Screens Breaking Along the Hinge
items.snippet:
Some iPhone Duos are already experiencing hinge issues that cause display cracks, based on photos shared on Reddit and the MacRumors forums. Almost all of the display faults are right along the hinge, and most result in a line of bright pixels across one side of the screen.





An iPhone Duo owner
items.line: Early iPhone Duo units report hinge-related screen cracks, raising durability concerns about the device's long-term reliability in real-world use.
